map.lux 和瓦数什么关系？: What is the relation between lux and wattage?
map.lux 是照度（落地的光），瓦数是耗电；中间靠光效 lm/W 连接。LED 光效: Lux is illuminance (the light landing on a surface) while wattage is power consumption; they are linked by the luminous efficacy lm/W. LEDs have high efficacy, so at the same lumen output they use far fewer watts than incandescent lamps.
